A prompt confirm on a fresh CRM client did succeed (FIX-hvac-002 RETRACTED/REVERIFIED_OK), so the race is at least reproducible on Jobs.

expected: Export includes the lens’s own panel records when any exist, or clearly scopes the export before use and still exports those records. An honest empty state is fine only when own-panel records are in scope and truly absent.
actual: Tried Export as CSV. The menu stated: “Nothing to export yet. This menu exports saved lens items, and there are none here. Records kept in this lens’s own panels aren’t included in this export yet, so nothing was downloaded.” No file was downloaded. No own records were present on this lens (it has no own-record form), but the menu explicitly excludes own-panel records.
note: Same RCA as FIX-mining-001, FIX-masonry-007, FIX-hvac-011, and FIX-ocean-007. Account zuko_qa_t1.
fix_note: Shared export now includes the caller's own STATE.<lens>Lens panel records (user-scoped maps and owned rows only).

title: Ask appends to an existing Mining Mine Plan conversation and claims capabilities the page does not show
repro_steps: From /lenses/command-center as zuko_qa_t1, with a prior Mining Mine Plan Ask conversation already present, use Ask about Command Center and ask: “What can I do in this Command Center lens?” After the answer appears, inspect the conversation list, the thread title, any thread id, and the URL, and compare the answer to the visible Command Center page. Do not delete the thread.
expected: The question opens or is filed under a new or clearly labelled Command Center thread, and the answer describes only capabilities evidenced on the Command Center page.
actual: The question was appended to the existing, unrelated Mining Mine Plan conversation rather than a new or Command Center thread. The conversation-list entry stayed titled “In the Mining lens’s Mine Plan view, what are the default pit depth and bench he...” and showed 4 messages. No thread ID was displayed; the URL only showed context=command-center. The answer claimed dashboards, alert-rule management, incidents, system health, runbooks, on-call schedules, and other capabilities not evidenced on the page, which showed only “No alert in front of you,” File an alert, and Refresh.
suspected_area: Ask / Chat thread routing and answer grounding
note: Also evidence/command-center/09-ask-thread.png. Wrong-thread routing cross-ref FIX-parenting-005 (and similar HVAC/Black Market/Marketing cases). Thread-identity leftover also relates to FIX-mining-006 (RCA-ask-silent), because this turn was added to that same Mining conversation and still has no visible thread id. Logged in reports/LEFTOVER_FIXTURES.md. Account zuko_qa_t1.
fix_note: Ask about a lens reuses that lens's thread or starts a new one, and permission or handler failures are explained without a raw tool name.

title: Light theme is mixed: white alert card on a dark shell [RCA-contrast-theme-tokens]
repro_steps: On /lenses/command-center, toggle the theme from Dark to Light and inspect the alert card and surrounding shell/navigation, then restore Dark.
expected: Light theme uses a consistent light surface and legible text and controls across the alert card and the surrounding shell.
actual: Light mode turned the alert card white while the surrounding shell and navigation remained dark, producing a mixed appearance. The control was cycled back to Dark and Dark was restored.
note: Also evidence/command-center/11-theme-restored-dark.png. Same RCA class as FIX-masonry-009 (mixed light theme) and FIX-mining-004. Account zuko_qa_t1.

title: No search, filter, or sort controls on Command Center

actual: No Command Center lens-level search, filter, or sort controls were present. The global Search button opens the “Search lenses” palette, not Command Center record search.
